title: Bacterial H-NS contacts DNA at the same irregularly spaced sites in both bridged and hemi-sequestered linear filaments.
authors: Shen, Beth A; Hustmyer, Christine M; Roston, Daniel; Wolfe, Michael B; Landick, Robert
one_liner_zh: 该文结合分子动力学、统计建模和化学足迹法研究细菌H-NS蛋白与DNA的线性/桥接丝状复合物中DBD-DNA接触位点，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作机制建模，方法可迁移至TF-DNA研究，但对象非典型TF体系。
abstract: Gene silencing in bacteria is mediated by chromatin proteins, of which Escherichia coli H-NS is a paradigmatic example. H-NS forms nucleoprotein filaments with either one or two DNA duplexes. However, the structures, arrangements of DNA-binding domains (DBDs), and positions of DBD-DNA contacts in linear and bridged filaments are uncertain. To characterize the H-NS DBD contacts that silence transcription by RNA polymerase, we combined .OH footprinting, molecular dynamics, statistical modeling, and DBD mapping using a chemical nuclease (Fe(2+)-EDTA) tethered to the DBDs (TEN-map). We find that H-NS DBDs contact DNA at indistinguishable locations in bridged or linear filaments and that the DBDs vary in orientation and position with  approximately 10-bp average spacing. Our results support a hemi-sequestration model of linear-to-bridged H-NS switching. Linear filaments able to inhibit only transcription initiation switch to bridged filaments able to inhibit both initiation and elongation using the same irregularly spaced DNA contacts.
abstract_zh: 细菌中的基因沉默由染色质蛋白介导，其中大肠杆菌H-NS是一个典型例子。H-NS形成含有一条或两条DNA双链体的核蛋白丝。然而，在线性和桥接丝中，DNA结合结构域（DBDs）的结构、排列以及DBD-DNA接触的位置尚不确定。为了表征H-NS DBD接触对RNA聚合酶转录沉默的作用，我们结合了.OH足迹法、分子动力学、统计建模以及使用化学核酸酶（Fe(2+)-EDTA）连接至DBDs（TEN-map）的DBD映射。我们发现，在桥接或线性丝中，H-NS DBDs与DNA接触的位置不可区分，且DBDs在取向和位置上变化，平均间距约为10 bp。我们的结果支持线性到桥接H-NS转换的半隔离模型。仅能抑制转录起始的线性丝转换为能同时抑制起始和延伸的桥接丝，使用相同的不规则间隔DNA接触。
